obligations.title: Health Software Requirements
obligations.verbatim: Apply risk management per ISO 14971 to the health software product. Risk management must cover the full product lifecycle. Include risks from: intended use environment, interoperability, data migration, IT security.
extracted_requirements: Apply ISO 14971 risk management at the product level (IEC 82304-1 mandates this; does not define its own risk process)
Risk management must span the full product lifecycle including maintenance and decommissioning

extracted_requirements.Risk assessment must include risks from: intended use environment, system interoperability, data migration, IT/cybersecurity threats

obligations.title: Safety Requirements Specification
obligations.verbatim: Software development must conform to IEC 62304. This is where the two standards connect — IEC 82304-1 requires IEC 62304 compliance.
extracted_requirements: All software development activities must conform to IEC 62304
IEC 82304-1 does not add development obligations beyond IEC 62304 — it mandates IEC 62304 conformance as the mechanism
Conformance records for IEC 62304 serve as the evidence base for IEC 82304-1 §4.3 compliance

obligations.title: Product Validation Planning
obligations.verbatim: Define the intended use of the health software product. Define the intended operating environment (hardware, OS, network, interfacing systems). Define the intended user profile.
extracted_requirements: Define the intended use of the health software product (maps to the FDA Indications for Use Statement)

extracted_requirements.Define the intended operating environmen: hardware platforms, OS versions, network requirements, interfacing systems (DICOM, PACS, C-arm)

extracted_requirements: Define the intended user profile (maps to IEC 62366-1 §5.1.1 user characterization)

obligations.title: Product Validation Execution
obligations.verbatim: Derive safety requirements from risk management activities. Include requirements for: data integrity, access control, confidentiality, audit trails. Address requirements for IT-network integration. Consider degraded performance modes.
extracted_requirements: Safety requirements must be derived from risk management (ISO 14971) activities — not authored independently

extracted_requirements.SRS must include requirements for: data integrity (guidance data cannot be silently corrupted), access control (patient data access scoped to authorized users), confidentiality (PHI protection), audit trails (who accessed/modified what data)

extracted_requirements: Address IT-network integration requirements (what happens when cloud sync is unavailable — Intra-Op must remain operable)
Define and specify degraded performance modes (graceful degradation when full capabilities unavailable)

obligations.title: Accompanying Documents
obligations.section: 6.1 — Health Software Product Life Cycle Plan
obligations.verbatim: Plan must cover the entire product lifecycle. Include provisions for: product deployment, operation, maintenance, and decommissioning.

extracted_requirements.The SDP (or a companion lifecycle plan): deployment, post-market operation, maintenance, and decommissioning

extracted_requirements.Define the planned product lifecycle: expected support period, planned major version cadence, end-of-support criteria

extracted_requirements.Address decommissioning requirements: data archival, patient safety during transition, user notification timeline

obligations.title: Post-Market Surveillance Plan
obligations.verbatim: Validate the health software product in the intended operating environment. Validation must demonstrate the product meets user needs and intended uses.
extracted_requirements: Validate MedTech Project in the intended operating environment (or validated simulation) — not just on a development server
Validation must demonstrate the product meets all defined user needs and the intended use statement
For SaMD with AI components, validation must include clinical performance testing (algorithm performance on representative patient data)

obligations.title: Post-Market Problem Resolution
obligations.verbatim: User documentation must include: intended use, operating environment requirements, installation instructions, user instructions, known limitations, security guidance.

extracted_requirements.IFU / user documentation must explicitly: intended use, intended operating environment (hardware, OS, network requirements)

extracted_requirements: Include installation and configuration instructions for the operating environment

extracted_requirements.Include security guidance for users: network configuration, access control setup, update process

extracted_requirements: For each PCCP change that modifies user-facing behavior, update the IFU accordingly

obligations.title: Decommissioning Plan
obligations.verbatim: Plan for orderly decommissioning of the software product. Address data migration, archival, and patient safety during transition. Notify users of decommissioning timeline and alternatives.

extracted_requirements.Define a decommissioning plan covering: data archival (surgical case records, patient data), migration path for active users, patient safety during service transition

extracted_requirements: Define the user notification timeline and process for end-of-support and decommissioning events
Address data retention obligations under applicable regulations (HIPAA records retention, FDA MDR records)
